title: Single Vendor Grocery Solution
bullets: Launch your branded grocery store with a complete package consisting of a Customer App, Customer Website, and central Admin Panel.
Equipped with a powerful Admin Panel designed to manage inventory, products, orders, customers, coupons, and reports from a single dashboard.
Includes an easy-to-use Delivery Boy App for staff to manage deliveries, get optimized routes, and update delivery status in real-time.
Offers a fully responsive Customer Website allowing users to browse items, pay securely, and track orders from any browser.
Optimized for quick local deliveries with automated order assignments and geographical routing integrations.

title: Food Delivery System
bullets: Complete food delivery ecosystem containing a Customer App, Restaurant App, Delivery Boy App, Customer Website, and central Admin Panel.
Features a dedicated Restaurant Panel and App for food outlets to manage their menus, update item pricing, and track incoming orders.
Includes a Delivery Boy App for riders to accept delivery requests, view optimized navigation, and manage daily payout reports.
Empowers users with a feature-rich mobile app and website featuring live GPS order tracking, ratings, and instant status notifications.
Configured with smart commission tracking, multi-payment options, and automated restaurant payout settlements.

title: Restaurant Ordering System
bullets: Launch a digital ordering system featuring a Customer App, Branch Manager Panel, Delivery App, Customer Website, and central Admin Panel.
Includes a Branch Panel for outlet managers to oversee location-specific operations, handle kitchen tickets, and monitor stock levels.
Equipped with an intuitive Customer Web and Mobile App to browse menu categories, place orders, apply discounts, and pay securely.
Features a Delivery Boy App for optimized routing, order status tracking, and cash-on-delivery collection logging.
Provides an Admin Control Center for central product catalog management, branch coordination, and global sales analytics.

title: On-Demand Services System
bullets: All-in-one multi-vendor handyman platform including a Customer App, Provider App, Provider Web Panel, and comprehensive Admin Panel.
Includes a Provider Web Panel and App for professionals to showcase services, adjust pricing hourly/fixed, and manage bookings.
Features a smart booking system supporting flexible time slot scheduling, appointment tracking, and instant in-app support chat.
Empowers administrators with a control dashboard to manage categories, verify provider credentials, set commissions, and view analytics.
Supports global accessibility out of the box with multi-language packages and right-to-left (RTL) text layouts.

title: Ride Sharing Complete System
bullets: Complete ride-sharing platform just like Uber, featuring a Customer App, Driver App, and central Administrator Panel.
Features a Customer App allowing users to request rides, select vehicle categories, calculate fares, and send packages/parcels.
Includes a Driver App with real-time bidding for rides, GPS route navigation, digital wallet, and performance bonus tracking.
Equipped with a comprehensive Admin Panel to verify driver documents, add/remove vehicles, monitor active trips, and track commissions.
Integrated with advanced location services and secure payment gateways for automated fare splits and driver payouts.

title: Multi/Single Vendor Ecommerce
bullets: Launch an Amazon-like marketplace with a comprehensive suite of Web App, Seller Panel, User App, Seller App, and Delivery App.
Includes a Seller Panel and App for vendors to manage catalog listings, handle bulk inventory uploads, track sales, and fulfill orders.
Features a native User App and responsive website for browsing products, comparing specs, tracking shipments, and secure checkout.
Equipped with a Delivery Agent App providing live navigation maps, task statuses, and instant delivery verification codes.
Provides a central Admin Dashboard to manage global settings, commission structures, vendor approvals, and marketplace advertisements.

title: Pharmacy Business Solution
bullets: Branded pharmacy e-commerce platform including a Customer App, Customer Website, Vendor Panel, and central Admin Panel.
Features a Customer App with digital prescription upload modules, visual category browsing, and order tracking integrations.
Includes a Vendor Panel for chemists to update medicine inventories, verify uploaded prescriptions, and process orders safely.
Equipped with a central Admin Panel for regulatory logs, seller approvals, medicine catalog indexing, and financial reports.
Supports multiple secure digital payment gateways and optimized delivery routing for temperature-sensitive medicine transit.
